negative_reviews.author: Saara Ess
negative_reviews.text:
The staff were so rude and probably racist.
We asked for the bill and asked for the NHS discount which meant the server had to go back to get a new bill which we didn’t realise was such an inconvenience. The smashed his hand on the table and scrumpled up the receipt then stormed off.
Absolutely unacceptable behaviour and very threatening towards a group of females. I don’t know how they hire such people. Ruined the whole experience.

negative_reviews.author: Lydia Qin Chang
negative_reviews.text:
Food was alright and everything, its just problems with management. I understand that they are trying their best but first of all they should get more staff.

1st time we came last week we waited for our food for an hour no kidding but the manager compensated us with ramen and drinks on the house. 2nd time we came here there was only 1 manager, 1 bartender and 2 waitresses managing the whole restaurant so there were so used bowls not cleaned up (and piling up further down the row) on the next to both sides of our table and it was left there the whole time even flies came. Our friends who were sat at another table waitress got their order wrong and didnt even place one order because it ran out of steak and he wasnt informed at all. His order was on the house in the end.

If service can be managed better my whole experience would be 5 stars. Even smaller restaurants have more staffs than this its ridiculous.

negative_reviews.author: Abdelrahman Rostom
negative_reviews.text: We waited 40 minutes for the food to arrive. The Soda machine wasn’t working. Food looks nothing like the pictures. Steak and Ramen was completely bland. Had zero flavour all I could taste with the spice and as a spice lover it was not even that spicy the meat was grey and I honestly had such high expectations from what I’ve seen online and I am very deeply disappointed.

deliveroo.source: Deliveroo_Master_Consolidation.xlsx — Weekly Summary. + ops from Weekly Summary sheet

issues: Another very big week on 5 GBP ramens; about 2,500 covers.
Delivery spikes: ran out of salmon and steak on Wednesday morning waiting on deliveries; a soft shell crab roll missed from a delivery bag.

Delivery station overflows at peak (three bags fit); proposal to use the side table as a permanent delivery overflow, Inka wants plates kept off it and the table moved beside the delivery station, away from table 14.
Labour target missed despite extra hours; food cost well over target while still running out of stock (noodles out last night).
Food and drink stock takes fine.
HRK off this week: Mag on six days, T on seven; Birmingham chefs may cover.

Reviews slipped: a review alleging discriminatory treatment (not emailed in, unverified), a 3 star on short staffing, a brutal one from last Monday (post mix soda machine down), and a 3 star on a 20 to 30 minute wait for the bill on a Monday with five staff on. Nicole answering reviews.
GM needs an experienced AGM and a supervisor who can hold service when not on site; Inka reopening both listings.
Hiring: full time FOH and a bartender needed; line chef trial Thursday (Mag); cannot see candidates on TalentFunnel.
Maintenance: still waiting on Ross for the toilet job.
Frozen ramen promo moved to the 19th; vouchers due.
Region: all broth now arrives pre diluted, chefs no longer add water on site (consistency fix for bland or salty broth complaints; Ross memo).
Region: Deliveroo integrated delivery app on an iPad plus an extra order summary printer per packing station; Inka will set each site up in person once delivered.
Region: focus on service, food quality and speed to retain the new 5 GBP ramen and app customers; managers free to schedule FOH retraining.
Covers rose by 97 (3.98%) week on week and spend per head fell by £0.59 (4%), with £5 ramen, free ramen, Deliveroo 30% off and Slerp all running.
Sales were up £440.85 (1.06%) week on week and £8,757.44 (25.40%) ahead of target in another very busy week of coinciding promotions.
Food cost was £12,624.40 (30.23%); noodles, sous vide chicken, tonkotsu broth, salmon and steak all went out of stock during the week, and lychee liquor and pineapple juice were out of stock at LWC.
The GM notes that the last 2,500 cover week took £61k, at which level labour would have been about 16%.
Items for the GM/HC meeting when the GM is back on site: the Thursday BOH trial, broth concerns (bland), and confirmation of an increased stock spend.
The GM suggested that if more managers are hired the FOH and bartender hires may not be needed, as hours are limited.
Upcoming: Slerp roll out, free ramen returning, £5 ramen still going strong and 30% off on Deliveroo.
Reviews, the management team and Deliveroo are the stated areas for improvement, and the GM thanked the team, especially the ramen chefs, for their hard work.
Over £12,000 of £5 and free ramen discounts left FOH and BOH staff exhausted, and Jamie and Felicia have been moved from Birmingham to Nottingham to help (AM Updates 14/10).
Pre shift plans are now in place (AM Updates 14/10).
Region: a level 8 Halloween ramen with a super spicy factory chilli paste is launching with a video; one bag per site, about a teaspoon per bowl (AM Updates 14/10).
Region: snooze out of stock items on both Deliverect and the POS, or the whole delivery order fails (AM Updates 14/10).
Region: wage revenue baseline is 21% with up to 2% leeway; drinks cost moves to management, food cost to head chefs, new OKRs due end of November (AM Updates 14/10).
Region: a temporary reserve stock buffer (about £300) was agreed for the English sites to stop stockouts (AM Updates 14/10).
